description: Source code for the RLC Transmission Entity for UM mode in a 5G NR protocol stack, including SDU handling, PDU creation, buffer management, and state updates.

classes.name: rlc_tx_um_entity
classes.description: Represents the Transmission Entity for Unacknowledged Mode in RLC, handling SDU queuing, PDU segmentation, and buffer management.

methods.name: handle_sdu
methods.description: Handles incoming SDUs, assigns PDCP SN, and queues them for transmission.

methods.name: discard_sdu
methods.description: Discards SDUs with specified PDCP SN from the queue.

methods.name: pull_pdu
methods.description: Creates and transmits PDUs based on available MAC buffer space, handling segmentation and SN updates.

methods.name: get_si_and_expected_header_size
methods.description: Determines the segmentation indicator and header size for a PDU based on SDU size and buffer space.

methods.name: handle_changed_buffer_state
methods.description: Triggers an update of the MAC buffer state to the lower layer if needed.

methods.name: update_mac_buffer_state
methods.description: Updates the MAC buffer state and notifies the lower layer.

methods.name: get_buffer_state
methods.description: Calculates the current buffer state, including pending bytes and SDU timing info.
